body: Manish Mohnot (MD & CEO) on 2025-02-14 (Q3FY25 concall transcript): "we are targeting to reach closer to 5% margins at the PBT level in Q4 itself, and I don't see us going down from there at least for the next couple of years" Metric: Standalone PBT margin. Target: ~5% in Q4FY25. Deadline: 2025-03-31. Specificity: precise; volunteered. Status as of 2026-11-21: delivered. Evidence: Q4FY25 standalone PBT 5.9% (company); screener 331/6,204 = 5.3%. FY26 standalone ~5.9% ex-exceptional; H1FY27 6.2%.
